title: FloodConnect M8 jev_decision
description: The answer's decision block -- replaces the old bare `sandwich` key (kb.py build_answer, M8 P-B wiring). Everything through `trace` is already computed by floodconnect_model.sandwich_decision/kb.py._answer_sandwich (P-A); `choice`/`noul`/`advice` are the new Jev-style envelope fields. `noul`'s N1-N6 definitions are not founder-confirmed -- see the INSTINCT placeholder note on each N field below; `choice.p` is always null (nothing in this repo computes a probability). `advice` is populated by P-C/P-D (advice.build()); in P-B alone it is present but may be an empty/minimal object -- a caller must not treat an empty `advice.prepare_steps` as 'no preparation needed'.
description_compact: VERIFIED against real build_answer() output (2026-10-05): the shape below (every property, `required` as listed) is what `verbose=True` returns in full. `verbose=False` (the DEFAULT) returns a DELIBERATELY SMALLER shape -- `kb.py`'s own `_compact_jev_decision` -- that keeps only colour/confidence/gate/layers/facts/chosen/prepare_steps/home_shelter and OMITS label_th/level/official_tier/score/choice/noul/licence/why/eq/trace entirely when `verbose=False` (token budget, tests/test_token_budget.py). `required` below is therefore loosened to `colour` alone (the one field present in EVERY real answer, both modes) rather than the full verbose field list, so this schema actually validates what both modes produce -- matching the precedent in layer_readout.schema.json, which already documents the real (compacted) answer.layers shape rather than floodconnect_model.ring_readout()'s own internal return shape.

level.description: FOLD_TO_LEGACY'd 4-value level (ORANGE folds to YELLOW) -- floodconnect_model.sandwich_decision's own `level` key.

official_tier.description: true only when the colour/word is the agency's own (ORANGE is explicitly false -- FloodConnect's own tier, never an agency tier).

scope.description: Founder ruling 2026-10-06: VALIDATED_MVP iff Z0 is a bma_watermap gauge (Sammakorn/Ram53's own BMA canal network) or the query point falls inside Bangkok metro -- the one area actually swept end to end. Everywhere else is EXPERIMENTAL -- not a claim that the answer there is wrong, only that it has not been swept the same way.

score.description: = the colour's own label_th, per the M8 schema design ('score (= the colour's label)'). Not a numeric score -- nothing in this repo computes one.

choice.description: fix (compact jev_decision): `verbose=False` keeps only `chosen` (the compact alt below) -- the full `options`/`p`/`audition` envelope is a `--verbose` detail (token budget, tests/test_token_budget.py), same documented pattern this schema's own `layers`/`advice.prepare_steps` already use.

p.description: Always null -- nothing computes a probability for this choice (M8 schema design: 'p stays null because nothing computes it').

oneOf.description: Compact form (verbose=False) -- see this property's own top-level description.

noul.description: N1-N6, each an s4 value. OPEN/INSTINCT (2026-10-05): the authoritative N1-N6 definitions exist only in the founder's design transcript and were not available to this implementation pass -- this placeholder mapping (N1 Z0 fresh, N2 Z0 vs bank, N3 trend, N4 upstream read, N5 middle confirms, N6 outlet) is a best-effort guess, not a founder-confirmed definition. A caller must not cite noul as settled without checking with the founder first.

gate.description: Default rule, pending the founder: RED->ESCALATE, UNKNOWN->HOLD, Z0 fresh and colour decided->ADMIT, chosen option conflicts with an official order->REJECT for that audition row.

eq.description: Toledo equation-status passthrough (PROP-FLOOD-01/02/11 tags) -- kb.py's existing `eq_status`, unchanged.

facts.description: Ranked critical rows (A2/A4 _rank_facts) -- see sandwich_trace for the ordering rule.

oneOf.description: Compact form (verbose=False): one letter per ring (Z0-Z3), G/Y/O/R/U -- advice/card.py's `_strip` and kb.py's `_compact_sandwich` both use this same single-letter encoding.

advice.description: Populated by advice.build() (P-C/P-D). Absent or minimal in a P-B-only build.

calc.description: (founder ruling 2026-10-06): the inputs behind the colour/headroom, trend and ETA sections, named so a caller sees WHICH input was missing rather than only a confidence number. Each of `colour`/`trend`/`eta` is shaped like advice.schema.json's own `calc` object (eq/inputs/missing/result, `reasons` when non-empty). `eta.result` is `GATED` when the Z0 trend is not RISING or the series lacks usable lag inputs, or a real `{warning, critical}` range-of-hours object (PROP-FLOOD-02, linear, two windows -- a registered, merged Toledo proposal, tier Dr; NOT PROP-FLOOD-11, which is registered but not implemented in this release, v0.2 target) when it is -- never a fixed GATED value. A short `range_h`-only summary is also carried on the compact (verbose=false) answer's own top-level `eta` field when RISING; this fuller `calc` block stays verbose-only, token budget.
